Connect by itself when plugged in (optional)
With USB debugging you don\'t have to turn on tethering every time you plug in. You only do this once:
1. In About device, tap «Build number» 7 times.
2. Go back, open «Developer options» and turn on «USB debugging».

Your device as a second screen
Extendesk turns your device into one more screen for your PC, over Wi-Fi or a USB cable. Three steps and you\'re done.
Run Extendesk-Setup.exe on the PC. It also installs the extra display, which is what lets you use the device as one more monitor.
Open Extendesk on the PC and press Start.
Quality and sound are chosen in the PC window. Everything else is automatic.
Wi-Fi is the easiest: with the PC and the device on the same network there\'s nothing to set up. Open Extendesk on both and press Connect.
Wi-Fi: the same network on the PC and on the device.
Cable, the most stable connection: plug in the device and turn on «USB tethering» in its settings.

Optional: with USB debugging the cable connects by itself when you plug it in, without repeating that step (About device, tap «Build number» 7 times, and in «Developer options» turn on «USB debugging»).
Make it look the way you like
The device starts at its own resolution, which is the sharpest. The size of everything is chosen in Windows: Settings > Display, picking the Extendesk display.
To make everything bigger, raise «Scale» (for example to 200 %) instead of lowering the resolution.
If you prefer another resolution, change it with the device connected: Extendesk remembers it.
The blue ☰ button in the corner opens the menu: statistics and disconnect.
If it covers something, drag it somewhere else and it stays there.
When you disconnect, the extra display disappears from the PC by itself.
Questions? Every option is explained in Advanced settings > Help.
